title: The 1904 check counts 1721 Prairie's frame house; narration stands in
items: The automated walk-through's list of what stands in 1904 now includes Wirt Dexter's 1863 frame house behind 1721 Prairie's brick front, which arrived without its entry.

The automated walk-through no longer reports an error because the narration host turns away its local test address: it uses an empty index, as though no tour has been voiced yet. What you see and hear is unchanged.
